caption: The drawing depicts the upper body of a figure resembling a carved wooden statue or bust, shown from the waist up. The figure is wearing a dark wide-brimmed hat with a tan-colored band, a brown jacket with large lapels and visible seams, and a red scarf or cravat around the neck. The face of the figure is exaggerated and stylized, with pronounced cheekbones, a broad nose, and wide, expressive eyes looking to the side. The mouth is open, showing teeth, and the facial expression appears animated. The figure’s arms are crossed. The hair is black and styled in thick locks that curl out from under the hat. The visible wood grain and glossy highlights suggest a varnished wooden texture. The background is plain and a light cream color, with no other objects or details present. The drawing uses realistic shading and a warm color palette, with a focus on browns, reds, and dark neutral tones.
title: Tavern Bust
